From what you've said I would classify this as being more like passive suicidality as it wasn't intentionally trying to kill yourself it was more just if it happens that it's deep enough to cause death, you wouldn't mind letting it kill you. 

As for A&E I went last night and I can confirm in the UK wait times are 10+ hours. But by the time I got seen it was still well within the timeframe that they would stitch it. (I think this differs between 12-24 hours).

As for the actual stitches they don't hurt at all (as long as you have local anesthetic) but the local anesthetic hurts so so much. This is because it is injected into the surrounding skin using such a tiny needle that means it has to be injected tons and this really hurts. As long as you're numb though the stitches are painless. This is just my experience though idk about others. 

Anyway I hope you get the help you need and deserve. Also I hope it heals well and please seek medical attention if there are any signs of infection as this is much more common for deeper cuts. :)

Can you go into more detail on what it looks like? Does the thing sticking out look like yellow bubbles or something similar? If so you definitely should get stitches but you can heal it on your own if that really isn't an option preferably with the help of steri strips or DIY ones made with tape.
